source_name: ЗАКОН / zakon.rada.gov.ua — DGF normative acts and executive-directorate decisions
why_relevant: The state legal database carries registered DGF executive-directorate decisions and the underlying Law 'Про систему гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб' (2012, No. 4452-VI), with full amendment history. Authoritative for the legal reporting obligations that make failed-bank disclosure mandatory, and a stable, machine-friendly alternative to the DGF's own document pages.

source_name: Ukrinform — тег «Фонд гарантування»
why_relevant: State news agency tag feed aggregating all DGF-related coverage into one chronological stream — a low-effort, high-recall monitoring channel for liquidation and asset-sale events, with an English edition available.

source_name: borg.expert — медіа-портал про борги та банкрутство
why_relevant: Niche Ukrainian portal focused on debt, insolvency and bankrupt-asset trading; publishes running totals of DGF asset volumes on sale and commentary on the distressed-asset market that no official source frames that way.

source_name: YouControl — company dossier for ФОНД ГАРАНТУВАННЯ ВКЛАДІВ ФІЗИЧНИХ ОСІБ (EDRPOU 21708016)
why_relevant: Commercial registry aggregator giving the DGF's legal identity (EDRPOU 21708016, registered 21.01.1999), officers, and court/enforcement links. The same platform can be used to resolve each failed bank's EDRPOU code and confirm the exact date of its termination in the Unified State Register — the hard timestamp for market exit.

source_name: IADI — global deposit insurance database and annual survey
why_relevant: The DGF is a member of IADI and EFDI. IADI's annual survey (114 respondents in the 2025 round) benchmarks coverage limits, funding and resolution powers across jurisdictions, letting Ukraine's failed-bank regime be placed against peers. Summary findings are public; respondent-level detail is members-only but obtainable on request by researchers.

source_name: World Bank — Note on the Strategic Development of an Enhanced Bank Resolution Framework for Ukraine
why_relevant: IFI diagnostic of the Ukrainian bank resolution framework against the EU acquis (BRRD/DGSD). Explains the institutional mechanics behind DGF disclosures and flags where the regime is expected to change under EU accession — context that shapes what future disclosure will look like.

source_name: Member-bank DGF disclosure pages (mandatory depositor-information publication)
why_relevant: Every DGF member bank is required to publish standardised information about the deposit guarantee system. Collectively these pages act as a distributed, timestamped index of who was a member when — and a bank quietly amending or removing its DGF page can be an early signal of status change. Low-value individually, useful as a cross-check panel.

source_name: ОСНАД / APOB — Орган суспільного нагляду за аудиторською діяльністю (official site)
why_relevant: Ukraine's public audit oversight body since 2019 (Law 2258-VIII). It is the master hub for who may audit public-interest entities (banks are PIEs), quality-control inspection outcomes, disciplinary decisions and register access. Every Ukrainian bank annual report is signed by a firm that must appear here, so this is the validation layer for the whole A1 disclosure workstream.

source_name: Реєстр аудиторів та суб'єктів аудиторської діяльності — public search interface
why_relevant: The authoritative register. Section IV lists the audit entities entitled to perform mandatory audits of public-interest entities — the only firms legally able to sign a Ukrainian bank's IFRS statements. Gives the universe of candidate bank auditors and their status/sanction history.

source_name: data.gov.ua open dataset: Реєстр аудиторів та суб'єктів аудиторської діяльності
why_relevant: Machine-readable dump of the auditor register (two resources: audit entities and individual auditors). Best bulk-ingest path for building an auditor master table to join against bank annual reports; open-data licence makes reuse unambiguous.

source_name: APOB — Результати проведення перевірок з контролю якості (quality-control inspection results)
why_relevant: Year-by-year (2019–2026) orders recording whether each audit firm passed quality-control inspection or was ordered to remediate. Directly qualifies the reliability of the auditor behind any bank's annual report — a credibility signal available nowhere else.

source_name: APOB — Дисциплінарні провадження (disciplinary proceedings)
why_relevant: Sanctions against auditors and audit entities performing mandatory audits. A sanction against a firm that signs bank statements is a leading indicator of restatement/qualification risk and of forced auditor rotation at its bank clients.

source_name: APOB — Інформація щодо обов'язкового аудиту фінансової звітності підприємств, що становлять суспільний інтерес
why_relevant: APOB's explanatory/notice thread on mandatory PIE audits, including the published перелік (list) of audit entities. Explains the legal frame that makes bank annual reports auditable and by whom — the interpretive key for the register data.

source_name: Закон України «Про аудит фінансової звітності та аудиторську діяльність» № 2258-VIII
why_relevant: Statutory basis for the transparency report (ст. 37), the register (ст. 21) and oversight (ст. 15). Defines exactly what an auditor must publish and when — i.e. what the collector is entitled to expect to exist for every bank auditor each year.

source_name: НБУ Постанова № 90 — Положення про подання банком аудиторського звіту (bank audit report submission rules)
why_relevant: The NBU rule governing bank/banking-group audit reports: deadlines, content, the auditor's duty to notify the NBU of violations next day, NBU's right to demand a repeat audit or auditor replacement. This is the timing calendar for when bank audit opinions exist and become disclosable.

source_name: PwC Україна — Звіт про прозорість (transparency report hub + annual PDF)
why_relevant: Art.37 transparency reports typically enumerate the PIE clients audited during the year — i.e. an explicit auditor→bank mapping, plus quality-management system detail, partner rotation and network structure. PwC UA is a major Ukrainian bank auditor.

source_name: KPMG Україна (ПрАТ «КПМГ Аудит») — Звіт про прозорість
why_relevant: KPMG Audit is a leading auditor of Ukrainian banks; its annual transparency report carries the client/PIE list, quality system and network data, dating each bank engagement.

source_name: EY в Україні (ТОВ «Ернст енд Янг Аудиторські послуги») — Звітність / Звіт про прозорість
why_relevant: EY Ukraine's reporting hub aggregates its Art.37 transparency reports (2018 onward). EY audits several Ukrainian banks/PIEs; the reports validate which entities it signed and under what quality regime.

source_name: Deloitte Ukraine (ТОВ «Делойт енд Туш ЮСК») — Governance / financial statements & management report pages
why_relevant: Deloitte Ukraine's governance section carries its own audited financials and management report; searches indicate a 2024 transparency report exists in this cluster. Deloitte is an active auditor of Ukrainian banks, so its client/PIE disclosures complete the Big Four mapping.

source_name: Grant Thornton Ukraine — Звіт про прозорість (Art.37 series)
why_relevant: Non-Big-Four but PIE-eligible network firm with a clean, dated transparency-report series (2022, 2023, 2024). Covers the mid-tier of Ukrainian bank auditing that the Big Four series misses.

source_name: Baker Tilly Ukraine — audit practice site (bank engagement evidence)
why_relevant: Mid-tier firm with documented Ukrainian bank audit engagements (e.g. its signed opinion appears in Bank Globus statements). Useful for auditor→bank attribution outside the Big Four and as a snowball seed for further mid-tier firms.

source_name: BDO Україна — audit firm site
why_relevant: Another PIE-capable network firm in Ukraine; needed to complete the auditor population beyond Big Four + GT. Transparency-report page not located in this pass.

source_name: Local Ukrainian audit firms' transparency reports (long tail, e.g. ТОВ «СОВА-Аудит»)
why_relevant: Smaller Ukrainian firms also publish Art.37 transparency reports on their own sites; some audit small banks and non-bank payment institutions that the international networks do not cover. Demonstrates the long-tail pattern (self-hosted PDF, no central aggregator).

source_name: Bank auditor-selection tender notices (Інформаційне повідомлення про конкурс з відбору суб'єктів аудиторської діяльності) — bank websites
why_relevant: Ukrainian banks must publicly announce competitions to select their statutory auditor. These notices are forward-looking pointers: they reveal auditor rotation, eligibility criteria (NBU requirements, register Section IV membership, 3-year bank client experience) and the audit calendar before the annual report exists.

source_name: Bank-hosted IFRS annual reports containing the independent auditor's report (Звіт незалежного аудитора)
why_relevant: The terminal artefact this cell validates: each bank publishes its IFRS statements with the signed independent auditor's report, naming the firm, the key partner, the opinion and key audit matters. Gives the ground-truth auditor→bank→year triple used to check register and transparency-report claims.

source_name: Аудиторська палата України (АПУ) — professional self-regulatory body
why_relevant: AПУ is the professional organisation of Ukrainian auditors (certification, standards, member base). Post-2023 the register moved to APOB, so АПУ is now a secondary/contextual source — useful for membership, certification and market-structure context, not as the authoritative register.

source_name: Academic / trade analyses of the Big Four in the Ukrainian audit market
why_relevant: Peer-reviewed analysis of Big Four financial performance and market share in Ukraine, plus the FAAF monograph on ISA-compliant audit reports in Ukrainian practice. Useful for interpreting concentration, fee levels and reporting-quality norms behind the raw register data.
